sources.document: Zonificacion Sismica - Geotecnica de la Ciudad de Paita
admissible_claims: the controlled Phase-2 inventory binds this official document to Paita city local-drainage discovery
the document is an admissible target for resolving named ravines and local drainage topology once primary bytes are frozen
forbidden_inferences: search-engine or secondary snippets are equivalent to archived primary-source bytes
named ravines have reproducible channel geometry before an official or reproducible spatial source is frozen
documentary drainage descriptions alone establish event footprints, hydraulic capacity, discharge or IRFEN thresholds

sources.institution: Municipalidad Provincial de Paita / CENEPRED SIGRID
sources.document: Informe de evaluacion de riesgos originado por deslizamiento del suelo en el area de influencia de la quebrada El Zanjon, caseta de Bombeo 1, Paita Alta
admissible_claims: the official 2021 EVAR independently confirms Quebrada El Zanjon as a named physical feature in Paita Alta
the EVAR is site-specific risk context around Caseta de Bombeo 1
forbidden_inferences: the EVAR proves a dated hydrologic activation of Quebrada El Zanjon
the EVAR ambit is a catchment boundary, outlet or observed event footprint
landslide-risk classes are IRFEN activation states or thresholds

sources.document: Paita RPAS topographic assets: curvas de nivel, DTM, DSM and orthomosaic
admissible_claims: SIGRID lists Paita RPAS terrain and orthomosaic products dated 09 May 2018 with centimetric nominal resolution over a bounded urban area
these products are candidate topographic inputs for future reproducible channel and blind-basin analysis
forbidden_inferences: RPAS coverage alone defines ravine catchments, channels or outlets
terrain depressions are observed flood footprints
derived flow paths may be published before the asset bytes, CRS and processing method are frozen
